item.title: Meduza: Ukraine destroyed the Crimean Bridge. Putin has vowed to retaliate, but Russia has repeatedly failed to bring down bridges in Ukraine. Can Moscow deliver?
item.description: Ukraine’s attack on the Crimean Bridge showed that destroying structures like this with strikes launched from hundreds of kilometers away, in the face of active enemy air defense and electronic warfare, is possible. Before this, Russia had spent several months proving the opposite: every attempt to put the Dnipro bridges out of commission for any length of time had failed. But now Putin is once again threatening Ukraine with “far more painful” consequences in response from the Russian military.
